scope: Read-only design; no benchmarks or builds run by this agent
adaptations: Drop old source locks, wall probe and VARIANTS; use current source_lock.json for float/double/dictionary.
field_support.process already records whole-process wall/CPU and Windows peak working-set/private commit at 10 ms intervals, with bounded child-tree kill.
Preserve input hashes, actual source counts, actual particles, completion marker and empty problem report.
Existing payload decoder supports only dense compressed V03 .grz; add sparse V02, coordinate V01 and unpacked paths for output regressions.
Set SG99 for unmodified source comparisons: all four readers still use emission_sourcegroup[101], so SG108 is a separate expected-failure boundary diagnostic.
Keep performance builds uninstrumented; use diagnostic builds separately for dictionary.Count, pre/post writer times and allocation/collection counters.

primary_cases.purpose: Many updates per occupied key; measure actual occupancy
Large dense buffer, many groups/heights, sparse occupied keys
Three meteorologies, emissions factors 1/0/0.5, residual-only middle situation and dictionary reset
Realistic medium rate and source/domain load

limited_extra_checks.purpose: Record current input-reader failure rather than claim dictionary lifts group limit
Double/dictionary values through all writer paths
One PM2.5 concentration+deposition source per original source; no source splitting; require nonzero .dep
Only if current branch changes odour P/M transfer; compare .odr shape/nonfinite/value behavior

statistics.pilot: Two representative cases, one cold run of each variant
statistics.screen: 1 discarded warmup plus 3 measured repeats per case/variant, rotating variant order
statistics.confirmation: Only important benefits/regressions or noisy cases: add 2 measured repeats
statistics.comparison: One-worker dictionary versus dense double is the strongest storage-preservation check; multi-worker values may differ only through order of floating-point addition, so retain exact counts plus magnitude and repeat envelopes. Float versus double is an accuracy change, not an exact-preservation criterion.

decoder_notes.v02: 20-byte <iiiff header, then runs (length,start_i,start_j,float32[length]) with 1-based indices, int32 -1 sentinel
decoder_notes.v01: int32 header then repeated <iif x,y,value> nonzero-coordinate records; uncompressed files same writer with header
decoder_notes.ascii: Six header rows; y reversed relative to internal i-major array
decoder_notes.deposition: Same three record formats, .dep has one field per source group (not per height); V02 writes values >1e-15

crucial_source_findings: Dictionary writer enumerates every dictionary entry once for each requested group and slice; test group/slice scaling, not only particle rate.
Clear() at the end of Write2DConcentrations should be tested over successive situations with changing emissions.
ReadPointSources, ReadAreaSources, ReadLinieSources, ReadTunnelportals still allocate emission_sourcegroup[101].
